# FilterOperator

```csharp
public enum FilterOperator
```

Namespace `SharpCell` · package `SharpCell`

How a [FilterCondition](SharpCell.FilterCondition.md) compares a cell with its value.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="equal"></a>`Equal` | 0 | The cell shows the value, ignoring case; `*` and `?` are wildcards, `~` escapes them. |
| <a id="notequal"></a>`NotEqual` | 1 | The cell does not show the value. |
| <a id="greaterthan"></a>`GreaterThan` | 2 | Greater than the value: a number than a number, a text than a text. |
| <a id="greaterthanorequal"></a>`GreaterThanOrEqual` | 3 | Greater than or equal to the value. |
| <a id="lessthan"></a>`LessThan` | 4 | Less than the value. |
| <a id="lessthanorequal"></a>`LessThanOrEqual` | 5 | Less than or equal to the value. |
